purpose: Native-speaker sentence evidence for translating Sahih al-Bukhari 1–100

ownerExamples.english: He gave food to that person.
ownerExamples.kashmiri: Temov deuot aiemis nafres kean khean

ownerExamples.english: They did not give food to that person.
ownerExamples.kashmiri: Temov deuot ne aiemis nafres kean khean

observations: The owner wrote ووٚن in both reporting sentences.
In the last two written phrases ne is added after deuot.
The word Temov was also previously used in an earlier sentence meaning They gave; clarify the singular/plural distinction before deriving a rule.
Preserve مےٚ and میہ exactly; do not silently conflate them.
